@syntax Single(value)
@syntax Single:Float32(value)
Converts a number or a text to a Single, another name of `Float` (a 32-bit real). `Single` is also accepted as a type in the long notation (`x:Single`) wherever `Float` is, together with `Float32`, `Real` and `Real32`, and all of them are the same type.

```blitzbasic
;run
x:Single = Single(7) / 2
Print x
Print x = Float(3.5)
```

```text
3.5
1
```
@param value  A number or a text with a number in it.
@returns The Single, which is a Float.
@gap Not in the originals, which only have `Float`.
